claim_one_line: STEP A v2, THE TIED HEAVY SECTOR'S ONE-LOOP VACUUM (P-518, P-519; data-free; refereed hostile, FAIL as drafted, the three blocking findings verified by main and applied): NEGATIVE as a compression. Under the plan's sealed reading (the global minimum isolated at every primary point) n = 1-3 fail (a flat valley; light-copy valleys; a runaway to the cusp and an unconverged point) and n = 4-8 pass only in a CHOSEN normalisation convention for the forms (3n - 2 continuous ratios) with the invariant cross-copy couplings and non-universal counterterms set to zero, and even there the plan's free-number measure is 3 at the primary points (numerically weak: one leading in the decoupling limit), against the two real numbers of tau a declared direction costs; with the convention free the vacuum's rank is 1-2 at n = 2 (in the heavy regime) and 3 (the whole fixed locus of a mirror line) or 6 (off the lines; computed at n = 5, 6, 8) for n >= 3, no compression; in the cusp and a Petersson-type convention n = 2-5 are light-copy at decoupling, so n = 2's heavy-regime vacuum is lost (none isolated found in the cusp convention at lambda v = 0.3); the supersymmetric reading the potential needs requires H_u (a lone H_d triplet is anomalous), whose direction is unfixed and whose identification with H_d is UNEARNED. Robust: two copies' direction is the formula Y1 x Y2 at tau* in every convention (rank 1 on a mirror line where the heavy regime holds); menu H's lands on R (a massless first generation). Step B keeps the declared directions (twelve, B1824). None of the 19.
